generatedCommentsNodes.comment: The update to `DeprecatedIndexPredicate.reindexRequired` (`#QBS3K`) to include an `includeSystem` flag correctly allows system resources to be identified for upgrade when explicitly requested (e.g., during a feature migration), while maintaining the default behavior of excluding them from general deprecation checks in other parts of the system (`#6B049`, `#EZ6E9`, `#ZGFD6`).

The addition of `DataStreamMigrationIT` (`#ZKT3X`) provides essential coverage for the new functionality, specifically testing the successful migration path and the ability to resume migration after a failure (simulated via `BlockingActionFilter`).

The refactoring of `SystemIndexDescriptor` and `SystemDataStreamDescriptor` to implement a shared `SystemResourceDescriptor` interface is a clean way to unify the management of different system resource types. This significantly simplifies the migration queue logic in `SystemIndexMigrator`, moving from specific index-based queues to a more generic resource-based approach (`#TJ688`).

The implementation of the polling mechanism in `SystemIndexMigrator.checkDataStreamMigrationStatus` (`#TF1DC`) correctly uses a scheduled task on the generic thread pool to monitor the progress of the asynchronous data stream reindex operation. The logic for handling existing failed migrations by cancelling and retrying is also present, which is necessary for robustness in persistent tasks.
